Counts of published derived values

Source: R/values.R
soil_values_summary.Rd

Counts the values a soil_values() selection holds, without reading them (POST /query/values/summary): in total, by variable, by dataset, by target level and by status.

Usage

soil_values_summary(
  soil = soil_session(),
  providers = NULL,
  datasets = NULL,
  variables = NULL,
  domains = NULL,
  measurement_kinds = NULL,
  target_levels = NULL,
  country = NULL,
  bbox = NULL,
  valid_at = NULL,
  depth_top_cm = NULL,
  depth_bottom_cm = NULL,
  product_versions = NULL,
  run_ids = NULL,
  statuses = NULL
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

providers

Provider codes of the targets ("isric"). API field providers.

datasets

Catalog dataset codes of the targets. API field datasets.

variables

Variable codes (see soil_variables()). API field variables.

domains

Domain codes of the variables. API field domains.

measurement_kinds

Measurement kinds of the variables ("derived", "modelled", ...). API field measurement_kinds.

target_levels

"feature", "profile", "component", "horizon". API field target_levels.

country

Countries as ISO 3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 codes or names. API field country.

bbox

c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in WGS84 degrees. API field bbox.

valid_at

A date-time (POSIXct, Date or ISO 8601 text): only the values valid at that instant (valid_time_start <= valid_at < valid_time_end, open ends included). API field valid_at.

depth_top_cm, depth_bottom_cm

Depth interval in cm: the values whose depth interval overlaps it (values without depth included). API fields depth_top_cm and depth_bottom_cm.

product_versions

Product version codes. API field product_versions.

run_ids

Run ids. API field run_ids.

statuses

Value statuses: "published", "insufficient_data", "not_applicable". API field statuses.

Value

A soil_values_summary list: total_value_count, feature_count, variables (data frame code, domain), by_dataset (data frame dataset, provider, value_count, feature_count, variable_count), by_target_level and by_status (named doubles), metadata.

Details

Rights: soil:summary. Capabilities: query_generic_values; country_filtering for country.

See also

Other thematic reads: soil_health_scores(), soil_health_summary(), soil_resolve_targets(), soil_ttr_flags(), soil_values()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
soil_values_summary(soil, country = "KEN")$by_status
} # }
